title: mentha gentilis var. pratensis
intro: Mentha gentilis var. pratensis, commonly known as sweet pennyroyal, is a type of herb belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its ability to aid digestion, reduce stress and anxiety, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha gentilis var. pratensis include its calming effects on the nervous system, its ability to ease menstrual cramps, and its potential to reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and isomenthone, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
